text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent! It was a tricky arrangement, 
so you did remarkably well.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Your concentration was so incredible that 
I found myself watching with bated breath, 
too.
choice_data_list: If you'd like, will you take this?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. So I never forget your hard work, 
Trainer, I'll make sure to display it in a 
nice spot in my room♪"
